detail.longDescription: Update regarding HortusFox 📢 👉 In the default dockerfile, PHP will be pinned from 8.3.0 to 8.3.36. 👉 Also added a fix to handle response codes properly returned from the HortusFox homepage in the context of version checks 👉 The HortusFox official homepage is still offline, no further response from my hoster.
